trivia.title: Trivia
trivia.empty: Facts appear here once there is enough history to talk about: two months of net worth, priced investments, a few months of spending and income, or warranties you track. The list is rebuilt each morning.
trivia.off: AI trivia is turned off. Turn it on in <link>AI Settings</link>.
trivia.aiGenerated: Written by AI from your figures

facts.netWorthSinceStart: Your net worth was {startAmount} in {startMonth}. It has gained {startGain} since then, so it is about {startMultiple} times larger.
facts.netWorthBiggestJump: {jumpMonth} was your biggest single-month jump. Net worth rose by {jumpAmount}, from {jumpFrom} in {jumpPreviousMonth} to {jumpTo}.
facts.netWorthHighPoint: Your high point was {peakAmount} in {peakMonth}. You're {peakBelow} below that now.
facts.netWorthAtHighPoint: You're at your high point: net worth has never been above {currentHigh}.
facts.netWorthBiggestDip: Your biggest dip took net worth from {dipFromAmount} in {dipFromMonth} to {dipToAmount} in {dipToMonth}, a fall of {dipPercent}.
facts.netWorthBiggestDipRecovered: Your biggest dip took net worth from {dipFromAmount} in {dipFromMonth} to {dipToAmount} in {dipToMonth}. You had recovered by {dipRecoveredMonth}.
facts.netWorthLargestAsset: {assetName} is worth {assetValue}, or {assetPercent} of your assets.
facts.investmentsShareOfAssets: Your investments are worth {investmentsValue}, which is {investmentsPercent} of your assets.
facts.investmentsGain: Your investments have gained {gainAmount} ({gainPercent}) over their {gainCostBasis} cost basis.
facts.investmentsLoss: Your investments are down {gainAmount} ({gainPercent}) from their {gainCostBasis} cost basis.
facts.investmentsCagr: Your investments' annualized return is about {cagrPercent} (CAGR).
facts.investmentsBiggestHolding: Your biggest holding is {holdingSymbol} at about {holdingPercent} of the portfolio ({holdingValue} in {holdingAccounts}).
facts.investmentsBestPerformer: Your best performer is {bestSymbol}, up {bestPercent}. It cost {bestCost} and is now worth {bestValue}.
facts.investmentsForeignAccount: Your {foreignName} account is held in {foreignCurrency}. Its {foreignBalance} of holdings equals {foreignConverted} at a rate of about {foreignRate}.
facts.investmentsLargestAccount: Your largest investment account is {largestName} at {largestValue}.
facts.spendingTopCategory: Over the last twelve months, {topCategoryName} took the most of your spending: {topCategoryAmount}, or {topCategoryPercent} of it.
facts.spendingTopPayee: Over the last twelve months, you spent the most with {topPayeeName}: {topPayeeAmount}.
facts.spendingBiggestMonth: {biggestSpendMonth} was your biggest spending month of the last twelve, at {biggestSpendAmount}.
facts.incomeKeptShare: Over the last twelve months you kept {keptAmount} of what came in, which is {keptPercent} of your income.
facts.incomeSurplusMonths: Months of the last {windowMonths} in which more came in than went out: {surplusMonths}.
facts.incomeTopSource: {topSourceName} brought in {topSourcePercent} of your income over the last twelve months.
facts.activityTransactions: Transactions in your registers: {transactionCount}, going back to {firstTransactionMonth}.
facts.activityPayees: Payees you keep in Monize: {payeeCount}. Categories: {categoryCount}.
facts.activityScheduled: Scheduled transactions Monize is tracking for you: {scheduledCount}.
facts.warrantiesCovered: Warranties you track that are still in cover: {warrantyCount}.
facts.warrantiesNextExpiry: The next warranty to run out is {nextWarrantyName}, in {nextWarrantyMonth}.
